text:
Priya: FYI cost ops flagged us-west-2 — safety pool dropped to 72% during Thurs evening burst. Thought the cap would prevent this.
Ken: Which autoscaler group is this hitting?
Priya: inference-prod-gpu-v2, policy=burst-large, window=10m, max_burst=60, safety_pool=30. We saw sustained >40 nodes for ~7m.
Maya: We allow short spikes but 7m sustained is bigger than expected. Any idea what drove it?
Priya: Looks like PartnerX rerank + a large self-serve QA job that kicked off at 19:12 UTC. Also our forecast shows a seasonal uptick — Black Friday prep traffic in the pipeline (we're projecting +18% next month).
Ken: Quick thought: tighten burst window and lower max_burst. Maybe window 10m -> 3m, max_burst 60 -> 40, and add a cool-off so repeated bursts within 30m don't re-open.
Maya: Agree. Also add per-region soft caps so us-west doesn't slurp capacity from other regions.
Priya: Draft patch for canary:
```
{
  "policy": "burst-large-v2",
  "window_seconds": 180,            // 3 minutes
  "max_burst_nodes": 40,
  "safety_pool_nodes": 30,
  "burst_cooloff_seconds": 1800,   // 30 minutes
  "per_region_soft_cap": {"us-west-2": 0.6}
}
```
Nora: Will that cause 429s for queued requests? We should ensure graceful fallback (smaller model) before denying.
Ken: We have a fallback route but it's not auto-enabled for this policy. Proposal: enable model-fallback with weighted routing and a small cached-completion token bucket at the edge.
Priya: I'll wire up fallback and cache grace tokens in the frontend. Also adding canary metrics to watch: safety_pool_util, burst_gpu_hours, avg_token_latency.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary of autoscaler-config v2026.03.176 on cluster inference-canary :rocket:
Maya: Run the canary for 2h. Watch GPU_hours, safety_pool_util > 60% for 5m -> page oncall. Also monitor cost signal: burst_gpu_hours_24h.
Priya: Created ticket INFRA-1248 and updated runbook with steps and rollback. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-1248
Ken: I'll open the PR for the config change and tag @eng-sre for review. :+1:
Maya: If canary looks good, roll to prod with gradual ramp: 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 3h. Keep verbose burst logs for 48h.
Priya: One more safety measure: add a cost-based guard — if burst_gpu_hours > 10k in 24h, auto-disable burst and notify finance & ops.
Ken: Adding metric name: `burst_gpu_hours_24h` and alert rule in prometheus.
ops-runbook-bot: incident-bot: playbook INFRA-1248 created and pinned to the channel.
Priya: Thanks — will follow up with the PR link and canary dashboard.
Maya: Good plan. Let's reconvene after the 2h canary window. :thumbsup:
